contract: Road user a overtakes and passes road user b: travelling with headings aligned, a goes from wholly behind b to wholly ahead of it. The act is recognized at the observation at which a becomes wholly ahead of b, that is, at which drv.position.behind of b relative to a becomes true, provided that a was behind b (drv.position.behind of a relative to b) at an earlier observation and the headings stayed aligned (rel.same_direction with the alignment tolerance) at every observation from that one to the recognition. Its observed beginning is the last observation at which a was behind b before the recognition. The concept holds at the recognition observation only. Where the recording shows no observation of a behind b before a becomes wholly ahead of it, with the headings aligned at every observation since the recording began, whether a overtook b is unknown, never false. Not a stand-in for a lane change or for contact between the bodies; it does not say in which lane either travels.

params.name: alignment
params.meaning: the cosine of the largest angle between the two headings counted as aligned

act.onset: Its observed beginning is the last observation at which a was behind b before the recognition.
act.recognition: The act is recognized at the observation at which a becomes wholly ahead of b
act.extent: The concept holds at the recognition observation only.
act.history: Where the recording shows no observation of a behind b before a becomes wholly ahead of it, with the headings aligned at every observation since the recording began, whether a overtook b is unknown, never false.

elements.span: drv.position.behind of b relative to a becomes true
elements.justification: drv.position.behind states one road user wholly behind the other with aligned headings; read both ways it gives the beginning (a behind b) and the recognition (b behind a).

elements.span: the headings stayed aligned (rel.same_direction with the alignment tolerance)
elements.justification: rel.same_direction: 'headings aligned: the cosine of the angle between the headings is above its tolerance'; held at every observation from the beginning to the recognition, so an oncoming crossing is no pass.

scenarios.name: holds
scenarios.narrative: a, in the left lane wholly behind b with aligned headings, comes alongside and becomes wholly ahead of b; the concept holds at that observation.

scenarios.name: fails
scenarios.narrative: a comes alongside b and stays alongside to the end of the recording, never wholly ahead.
